ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57169  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, November 12, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57170  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent's Update on Citywide Senior

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
